svg.title: Gaussian smoothing of a particle field. The kernel width is a length measured on the particles (the median distance to the 4th neighbour), so the same physical blur is covered by twice as many voxels on a grid of twice the resolution.
svg.text: particles: position, weight w, emission colour c
after a Gaussian of width σ
every particle spread by the same kernel, so the gaps fill in
σ is a length in world units, so a finer grid spends more voxels on the same blur
ℓ = median distance from a particle to its 4th neighbour
σ = 0.85 ℓ, in world units of the box
